name: Invite members
summary: Invite several people at once: emails become removable chips, one role applies to all with a line on what it can do, and a seat count shows what the invites use.
use: when adding people to a workspace or team
a11y: The email field is a labelled input; each chip has a remove button that names the address, Backspace removes the last chip, the role is a native select described by its explanation, and errors are tied to the field.
